column1: Situação: Segunda-feira: perguntar como foi o fim de semana
column2:
[sound:st_audio_01.mp3] "How was your weekend? Did you get up to anything exciting?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_01.mp3] "Do anything fun over the weekend, or mostly just chill?"

column1: Situação: Segunda-feira: responder que descansou e ficou em casa
column2:
[sound:st_audio_02.mp3] "It was pretty quiet, mostly just recharged and caught up on some reading."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_02.mp3] "Pretty low-key weekend! Just relaxed at home."

column1: Situação: Sexta-feira: perguntar sobre os planos do fim de semana
column2:
[sound:st_audio_03.mp3] "Any exciting plans lined up for the weekend?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_03.mp3] "Counting down the hours until the weekend—doing anything fun?"

column1: Situação: Sexta-feira: desejar um ótimo fim de semana ao time
column2:
[sound:st_audio_04.mp3] "Have a fantastic weekend, everyone! Rest up and see you Monday."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_04.mp3] "Have a good one, folks! Enjoy your time off."

column1: Situação: Responder a 'How are you doing?' em um dia agitado de incidentes
column2:
[sound:st_audio_05.mp3] "Doing well, hanging in there! It's been a busy morning with the deployment."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_05.mp3] "Staying afloat! Crazy morning, but getting through it."

column1: Situação: Responder a 'How's it going?' no início do expediente
column2:
[sound:st_audio_06.mp3] "Doing great! Just grabbing my first coffee of the day and getting settled in."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_06.mp3] "Can't complain! Just caffeinating before our standup."

column1: Situação: Enquanto esperam mais colegas entrarem na chamada de vídeo
column2:
[sound:st_audio_07.mp3] "Let's give folks another minute or two to trickle in before we dive in."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_07.mp3] "Looks like people are still hopping on; let's give it another minute."

column1: Situação: Avisar que já temos quórum suficiente para começar a reunião
column2:
[sound:st_audio_08.mp3] "Looks like we have critical mass, so let's go ahead and get started."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_08.mp3] "We've got mostly everyone, so let's jump right in."

column1: Situação: Comentar educadamente sobre a diferença de fuso horário
column2:
[sound:st_audio_09.mp3] "I really appreciate you accommodating my timezone for this late afternoon sync!"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_09.mp3] "Thanks for taking this call so early in your morning—super appreciated!"

column1: Situação: Perguntar como está o clima no país do colega
column2:
[sound:st_audio_10.mp3] "How's the weather on your end? It's pretty warm and sunny here in Brazil today."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_10.mp3] "Is it starting to feel like winter over there yet?"

column1: Situação: Elogiar o setup / ambiente de trabalho visível na câmera
column2:
[sound:st_audio_11.mp3] "By the way, I love that desk setup in your background! Is that an ultrawide monitor?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_11.mp3] "Nice setup! That mechanical keyboard looks awesome."

column1: Situação: Quebrar o gelo antes de uma reunião individual (1-on-1)
column2:
[sound:st_audio_12.mp3] "How have things been feeling for you this sprint? How is your workload?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_12.mp3] "How's life treating you lately? Feeling good about the sprint pace?"

column1: Situação: Comentar sobre um animal de estimação que apareceu na câmera
column2:
[sound:st_audio_13.mp3] "Looks like your cat decided to join the standup! What's their name?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_13.mp3] "Love the guest appearance! Your dog is adorable."

column1: Situação: Avisar que alguém precisou se ausentar por um minuto
column2:
[sound:st_audio_14.mp3] "John mentioned in Slack that he's stepping away for a quick minute to grab coffee."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_14.mp3] "John had to step away for a second, he'll be right back."

column1: Situação: Perguntar sobre planos para feriados próximos
column2:
[sound:st_audio_15.mp3] "Are you taking any time off for the upcoming holidays, or staying in town?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_15.mp3] "Got any holiday travel planned, or taking it easy at home?"

column1: Situação: Parabenizar colega pelo aniversário ou marco de tempo na empresa
column2:
[sound:st_audio_16.mp3] "Huge happy work anniversary! Can't believe it's already been two years!"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_16.mp3] "Happy anniversary on the team! Time really flies."

column1: Situação: Comentar sobre café ou chá no início do dia
column2:
[sound:st_audio_17.mp3] "Are you more of a coffee or tea person to survive morning meetings?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_17.mp3] "I definitely need a second cup of coffee before looking at these logs!"

column1: Situação: Desculpar-se educadamente por um barulho de fundo na sua casa
column2:
[sound:st_audio_18.mp3] "Sorry about the background noise—there's some construction happening next door."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_18.mp3] "Apologies for the noise, my dog just decided the mailman is dangerous!"

column1: Situação: Comentar sobre eventos esportivos ou finais de campeonatos
column2:
[sound:st_audio_19.mp3] "Did you happen to catch the championship game over the weekend?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_19.mp3] "Did you watch the match yesterday? What an incredible ending!"

column1: Situação: Responder educadamente quando perguntam de onde você é no Brasil
column2:
[sound:st_audio_20.mp3] "I'm based in Belo Horizonte, in southeastern Brazil. It's known for great food and mountains!"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_20.mp3] "I'm working from Belo Horizonte—definitely reach out if you ever visit Brazil!"

column1: Situação: Perguntar sobre a cidade onde o colega mora
column2:
[sound:st_audio_21.mp3] "Have you lived in Seattle for a long time, or did you relocate recently?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_21.mp3] "How do you like living in London? I hear the tech scene there is booming."

column1: Situação: Expressar solidariedade quando um colega esteve doente
column2:
[sound:st_audio_22.mp3] "Glad to have you back! Hope you're feeling much better now."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_22.mp3] "Good to see you back on your feet! Don't push yourself too hard today."

column1: Situação: Comentar sobre novos gadgets ou lançamentos tecnológicos
column2:
[sound:st_audio_23.mp3] "Did you see the latest Google I/O announcements? Some pretty wild AI features!"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_23.mp3] "Did you check out the keynote yesterday? Really cool stuff on developer tooling."

column1: Situação: Encerrar o papo inicial e transicionar para a pauta da reunião
column2:
[sound:st_audio_24.mp3] "Well, as much as I'd love to chat, I know we have a packed agenda today. Shall we kick off?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_24.mp3] "Alright, let's pivot to the agenda so we give everyone their time back."

column1: Situação: Avisar que você vai fechar a câmera para comer algo rápido
column2:
[sound:st_audio_25.mp3] "Mind if I keep my camera off for the first few minutes? Just finishing up a quick lunch."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_25.mp3] "Gonna go camera-off while I grab a bite, but I'm listening in!"

column1: Situação: Perguntar sobre recomendações de livros, séries ou podcasts
column2:
[sound:st_audio_26.mp3] "Have you listened to any good tech podcasts lately? Always looking for recommendations."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_26.mp3] "Watched anything good on Netflix recently? Looking for weekend show ideas."

column1: Situação: Agradecer a parceria de um colega no final de um projeto difícil
column2:
[sound:st_audio_27.mp3] "Just wanted to say it's been an absolute pleasure collaborating with you on this release."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_27.mp3] "Really enjoyed pairing with you this sprint—learned a ton!"

column1: Situação: Fazer piada sobre dias em que tudo parece acontecer ao mesmo tempo
column2:
[sound:st_audio_28.mp3] "One of those Mondays where the coffee needs to kick in before the brain starts working!"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_28.mp3] "Classic release week—never a dull moment around here!"

column1: Situação: Perguntar se a semana está tranquila ou corrida
column2:
[sound:st_audio_29.mp3] "How is your week shaping up so far? Pretty manageable or meeting-heavy?"

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_29.mp3] "How's your calendar looking this week? Surviving the meeting marathon?"

column1: Situação: Desejar bom descanso no fim do dia
column2:
[sound:st_audio_30.mp3] "Have a restful evening! Catch you all first thing in the morning."

Alternativa casual: [sound:st_audio_casual_30.mp3] "Enjoy the rest of your evening, folks! Talk soon."
